tools.name: investigate_token
tools.description: Run a V.A.P.E. deep on-chain investigation on a Base token/contract (GoPlus + DexScreener + Base RPC + hack-feed) -> 0-100 safety score and PROCEED/CAUTION/REJECT verdict with evidence. Read-only.

tools.name: scan_token_safety
tools.description: Fast token safety scan (GoPlus honeypot/tax/owner powers + DexScreener liquidity) returning a verdict. Read-only, keyless.

tools.name: recent_hacks
tools.description: Recent DeFi exploits/hacks from the DeFiLlama feed (dated, $ lost, chain, technique). Keyless.

tools.name: fear_greed
tools.description: Current crypto Fear & Greed index (market mood). Keyless.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Query V.A.P.E. Central Memory (SQLite-indexed findings/lessons/skills). Supports free text, category, and days-back filters.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Counts across V.A.P.E. Central Memory (by category, severity, high-confidence).

tools.name: research_search
tools.description: Web search via the best available provider (Tavily/Brave when keyed, keyless fallback otherwise) for bounties, protocols, CVEs, incidents.

tools.name: research_scrape
tools.description: Scrape a page to clean text/markdown via the best available provider (Firecrawl/BrightData/Apify when keyed, keyless MCP fetch otherwise).

tools.name: mcp_servers
tools.description: List the MCP servers VAPE can host (reference + community search/scrape) and whether each is live, key-gated, or needs a runtime.

tools.name: web_research
tools.description: Intelligent research crawler: search + robots.txt-respecting scrape into tagged, deduplicated leads (on-chain addresses/tx hashes/CVEs/$TICKERs auto-extracted). max_depth>1 turns on LLM-scored link-following (finds e.g. a news article's linked exploit report or GitHub issue). Persistent cross-run cache/dedup under data/cache/web_sourcer/. Same free-to-call in-process capability other VAPE agents use internally; the external, x402-payable equivalent for third-party agents is the /scan/web_research Worker route ($0.01/call).

tools.name: wallet_trace
tools.description: Wallet/address forensics via Alchemy's Transfers API: recent transfers (any asset or ERC-20 only) or first-seen transfer (funding source). Base/Ethereum/Arbitrum/Optimism. Needs VAPE_TRACE_ALCHEMY_API.

tools.name: contract_source
tools.description: Contract verification status + source/ABI metadata via Etherscan V2 (free tier). Needs ETHERSCAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: global_market
tools.description: Global crypto market snapshot: BTC/ETH dominance, 24h market-cap change. Keyless.

tools.name: defillama_token_intel
tools.description: DefiLlama's full picture of a token: current + first-seen price, and (with a protocol slug) fees/revenue, unlocks, and treasury. Keyless.

tools.name: defillama_chain_overview
tools.description: A chain's headline TVL + rank among all tracked chains (DefiLlama). Keyless.

tools.name: defillama_protocols_on_chain
tools.description: Top protocols on a chain by TVL, with category and 24h/7d change. Keyless.

tools.name: defillama_yield_pools
tools.description: Yield pools filtered by chain/project/symbol, ranked by TVL, with APY/IL-risk/exposure — enough to spot a yield trap. Keyless.

tools.name: bounty_radar
tools.description: Real, currently-tracked bug-bounty/incident-lead opportunities (Immunefi/Sherlock/DeFiLlama hacks), ranked by VAPE's own numeric fit score. Never LLM-scored.
